vote.sos.ri.gov.en: the Rhode Island Department of State
vote.sos.ri.gov.es: el Departamento de Estado de Rhode Island

reg_deadline.en: Registration for November 3 closed 30 days before the election, on October 4, 2026. Not sure you're registered? Check the Voter Information Center at vote.ri.gov.
reg_deadline.es: El registro para el 3 de noviembre cerró 30 días antes de la elección, el 4 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa el Voter Information Center en vote.ri.gov.
reg_deadline.quote: Registration for any election shall close on the thirtieth (30th) day preceding an election

mail_request.en: Applications closed at 4 p.m. on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. You can still vote early in person or on Election Day.
mail_request.es: Las solicitudes cerraron a las 4 p. m. del martes 13 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona o el Día de las Elecciones.
mail_request.quote: Voters who complete their mail ballot application and return it, or apply online, by the deadline (October 13, 2026 at 4 p.m.) will have a mail ballot sent to them.

mail_return.en: Drop box: by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. Mail: send it by Tuesday, October 27, at least seven days before Election Day, because it has to reach the State Board of Elections by 8 p.m. on November 3.
mail_return.es: Buzón: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Correo: mándala a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre, al menos siete días antes del Día de las Elecciones, porque tiene que llegar a la Junta Electoral del Estado (State Board of Elections) a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.
mail_return.quote: If you’re mailing your ballot, be sure to get it in the mail at least seven days before Election Day.
mail_return.en_after: Use a drop box by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3. It's too late to count on the mail: your ballot has to reach the State Board of Elections by 8 p.m. that day. Every polling place has a drop box too.
mail_return.es_after: Usa un buzón de entrega a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre. Ya es tarde para confiar en el correo: tu boleta tiene que llegar a la Junta Electoral del Estado (State Board of Elections) a más tardar a las 8 p. m. de ese día. Cada lugar de votación también tiene un buzón.

early_hours.en: Early voting is at a location your city or town picks, during its regular business hours, and ends at 4 p.m. on Monday, November 2. Call your local board of canvassers for hours.
early_hours.es: La votación anticipada es en un lugar que elige tu ciudad o municipio, durante su horario normal de oficina, y termina a las 4 p. m. del lunes 2 de noviembre. Llama a la junta de escrutinio local (local board of canvassers) para saber el horario.
early_hours.quote: Early voting will begin on October 14 and end at 4 p.m. on November 2.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended at 4 p.m. on November 2. Vote at your polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. (9 a.m. to 8 p.m. in New Shoreham).
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó a las 4 p. m. del 2 de noviembre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. (de 9 a. m. a 8 p. m. en New Shoreham).

in_person.en: Vote early at the location your city or town designates, or at your polling place on Election Day. Already applied for a mail ballot? If you go to a polling place on Election Day, you'll vote a provisional ballot.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en el lugar que designe tu ciudad o municipio, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. ¿Ya pediste una boleta por correo? Si vas a un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, votarás con una boleta provisional.
in_person.quote: Any person who applied for a mail ballot and attempts to vote at a polling place on Election Day will have to cast a provisional ballot.

rule.en: Find your early voting location, the nearest mail ballot drop box and your Election Day polling place at vote.ri.gov, or ask your local board of canvassers.
rule.es: Busca tu lugar de votación anticipada, el buzón de entrega más cercano y tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones en vote.ri.gov, o pregunta en la junta de escrutinio local (local board of canvassers).
rule.quote: Your early voting location can be found online at vote.ri.gov or by contacting your local board of canvassers.

en: Rhode Island voter identification card, free from the Secretary of State
ID card from a U.S. school, college or university
ID card issued by the United States or the State of Rhode Island
es: Licencia de conducir de Rhode Island
Tarjeta de identificación de votante de Rhode Island, gratis de la Secretaría de Estado
Identificación de una escuela, colegio o universidad de EE. UU.
Tarjeta de identificación militar de EE. UU.
Tarjeta de identificación de Estados Unidos o del estado de Rhode Island
Tarjeta médica emitida por el gobierno
accepted.quote: A valid and current document showing a photograph of the person to whom the document was issued, including without limitation:

expired.en: Your ID can be expired up to six months.
expired.es: Tu identificación puede tener hasta seis meses de vencida.
expired.quote: For purposes of this section, proof of identity shall be valid if unexpired or expired no more than six (6) months prior to voting

without.en: No photo ID? You can still vote a provisional ballot. Your local board compares the signature on your application with the one on your registration, and if they match, your ballot counts.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación con foto? Igual puedes votar con una boleta provisional. La junta local compara la firma de tu solicitud con la de tu registro, y si coinciden, tu boleta cuenta.
without.quote: If the local board determines that the signatures match, the provisional ballot shall count.

who.en: Any Rhode Island voter who'd rather not vote in person can vote by mail. Accessible mail ballots are offered too.
who.es: Cualquier votante de Rhode Island que prefiera no votar en persona puede votar por correo. También hay boletas por correo accesibles.
who.quote: Voting by mail is a safe and easy option for those voters who do not want to vote in person.

witness.en: Seal your ballot in the certificate envelope, then sign and date it. Can't sign your name? An assistant fills out the Voter Assistant Certification.
witness.es: Cierra tu boleta en el sobre de certificado (Voter's Mail Ballot Certificate Envelope), y fírmalo y ponle la fecha. ¿No puedes firmar? Una persona que te ayude llena la certificación de asistente (Voter Assistant Certification).
witness.quote: Voters casting a ballot by mail who are unable to sign their name may be aided by a Voter Assistant, who must complete the Voter Assistant Certification.

dropbox.en: Drop it in a 24-hour elections drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day. Every polling place also has a drop box for mail ballots.
dropbox.es: Déjala en un buzón electoral abierto las 24 horas a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Cada lugar de votación también tiene un buzón para boletas por correo.
dropbox.quote: NOTE: All polling places will also have drop boxes for your voted mail ballot.

gear.en: Leave the campaign flyers and signs outside the 50-foot line. Posters, papers or other material for or against a candidate, party or ballot question can't be handed out or displayed inside the voting place or within 50 feet of the building's entrances.
gear.es: Deja los volantes y letreros de campaña fuera de la línea de 50 pies. No se pueden repartir ni mostrar carteles, papeles u otro material a favor o en contra de un candidato, un partido o una pregunta de la boleta dentro del lugar de votación ni a menos de 50 pies de las entradas del edificio.
gear.quote: No poster, paper, circular, or other document designed or tending to aid, injure, or defeat any candidate for public office or any political party on any question submitted to the voters shall be distributed or displayed within the voting place or within fifty (50) feet of the entrance or entrances to the building in which voting is conducted at any primary or election.

line.en: In line at 8 p.m.? Stay in line. Anyone waiting in line to vote at 8 p.m. gets to vote.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila a las 8 p. m.? Quédate en la fila. Cualquier persona que esté esperando en la fila para votar a las 8 p. m. puede votar.
line.quote: provided, that any qualified voter who is waiting in line to vote at 8 p.m. shall be entitled to cast his or her vote.

tradition.en: After you put your ballot in the voting machine, wear your I Voted sticker. The Department of State's 2026 voter handbook says so.
tradition.es: Después de meter tu boleta en la máquina de votación, ponte tu sticker de I Voted. Lo dice el manual del votante 2026 del Departamento de Estado.

early.en: Yes. The Department of State's early voting steps end with returning the empty secrecy folder and wearing your "I voted" sticker.
early.es: Sí. Los pasos de la votación anticipada del Departamento de Estado terminan con devolver la carpeta de privacidad vacía y ponerte tu sticker de "I voted".

mail.en: Look in your mail ballot packet. The Department of State lists an "I Voted by Mail" sticker among the items it includes.
mail.es: Revisa tu paquete de boleta por correo. El Departamento de Estado incluye un sticker de "I Voted by Mail" entre los artículos del paquete.

provisional.en: You vote a provisional ballot if your name isn't on the voter list, you don't have an acceptable photo ID, you applied for a mail ballot, or there's another question about your eligibility. Your local board of canvassers decides after Election Day whether it counts. Check the result at elections.ri.gov or by calling 401-222-2345.
provisional.es: Votas con una boleta provisional si tu nombre no está en la lista de votantes, no tienes una identificación con foto aceptada, pediste una boleta por correo o hay otra duda sobre si puedes votar. La junta de escrutinio local (local board of canvassers) decide después del Día de las Elecciones si cuenta. Revisa el resultado en elections.ri.gov o llamando al 401-222-2345.
provisional.quote: The voter may learn the disposition of the ballot by visiting elections.ri.gov or by calling the State Board of Elections at 401-222-2345.

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone waiting in line to vote at 8 p.m. gets to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Cualquier persona que esté esperando en la fila para votar a las 8 p. m. puede votar.
line.quote: provided, that any qualified voter who is waiting in line to vote at 8 p.m. shall be entitled to cast his or her vote.

track.en: Sign up at vote.ri.gov to track your mail ballot. You'll get updates when it's mailed to you and when the Board of Elections receives it.
track.es: Inscríbete en vote.ri.gov para seguir tu boleta por correo. Recibirás avisos cuando te la envíen y cuando la reciba la Junta Electoral (Board of Elections).
track.quote: You will receive updates when your ballot is placed in the mail and when it is received by the Board of Elections for certification.

notes: Read October 21, 2026. vote.sos.ri.gov and elections.ri.gov HTML pages return 403 to curl; the 2026 Rhode Island Voter Information Handbook PDF (vote.sos.ri.gov/Forms/Elections/Guides/VoterRef26.pdf, read with pdftotext) and RI General Laws on webserver.rilegislature.gov (17-9.1-3, 17-18-11, 17-19-24.2, 17-19-24.3, 17-19-49) were used. vote.ri.gov 301-redirects to vote.sos.ri.gov. Early voting dates match states.js (October 14 to November 2); the handbook adds that early voting ends at 4 p.m. on November 2 ('Early voting will begin on October 14 and end at 4 p.m. on November 2.') and elsewhere says 'during their regular business hours'. Registration: October 4, 2026 is a Sunday and 17-9.1-3 says local boards don't take registrations on Sundays; the file states the 30-day rule and date, as the FAQ does. The October 27 mail-by date is the handbook's 'at least seven days before Election Day', not a separate official date. Mail ballot cure, phone rules, first-time voter rules and a sticker contest on an official page were not found; left missing. The Board of Elections' sticker contest (reported by ABC6) is on elections.ri.gov, which returns 403. No county or town office list URL was confirmed online (the handbook lists local boards of canvassers on page 17).
